# Forage Ireland

> A free guide to wild food in Ireland: which wild plants are in season in each region and month, how to recognise and harvest them, the dangerous lookalikes to avoid, and 39 dishes to cook with them.

Seasons and ranges are approximate. Every plant should be confirmed with an experienced local forager before eating.

- [App](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/): pick a region and month to see what is wild near you
- [All wild plants](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/plants/)
- [All dishes](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/)

## Wild plants

- [Stinging nettle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/plants/nettle/): Urtica dioica; Nettle, Neantóg. In season March to June.
- [Wild garlic](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/plants/wildgarlic/): Allium ursinum; Ramsons, Creamh. In season March to May.
- [Three-cornered leek](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/plants/threecorner/): Allium triquetrum; Three-cornered leek, Wild onion. In season February to May.
- [Dandelion](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/plants/dandelion/): Taraxacum officinale; Dandelion, Caisearbhán. In season March to October.
- [Ground elder](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/plants/groundelder/): Aegopodium podagraria; Ground elder, Lus an easpaig. In season March to June.
- [Chickweed](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/plants/chickweed/): Stellaria media; Chickweed, Fliodh. In season March to November.
- [Common sorrel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/plants/sorrel/): Rumex acetosa; Sorrel, Samhadh. In season April to August.
- [Wood sorrel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/plants/woodsorrel/): Oxalis acetosella; Wood sorrel, Seamsóg. In season April to September.
- [Garlic mustard](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/plants/garlicmustard/): Alliaria petiolata; Jack-by-the-hedge, Bóchoinneal. In season March to June.
- [Fat hen](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/plants/fathen/): Chenopodium album; Fat hen, Praiseach fhiáin. In season May to September.
- [Ribwort plantain](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/plants/plantain/): Plantago lanceolata; Ribwort plantain, Slánlus. In season April to September.
- [Watercress](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/plants/watercress/): Nasturtium officinale; Watercress, Biolar. In season March to October.

- [Carrageen moss](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/plants/carrageen/): Chondrus crispus; Carrageen, Irish moss, Carraigín. In season April to August.

- [Blue mussels](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/plants/mussel/): Mytilus edulis; Mussels, Diúilicín. In season January to December.
- [Periwinkles](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/plants/periwinkle/): Littorina littorea; Periwinkles, Winkles, Faocha. In season January to December.
- [Spruce tips](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/plants/spruce/): Picea abies; Spruce tips, Sprús. In season May to June.
- [Blackberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/plants/blackberry/): Rubus fruticosus; Blackberry, Bramble, Sméar dhubh. In season August to September.
- [Wild raspberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/plants/raspberry/): Rubus idaeus; Wild raspberry, Sú craobh. In season July to August.
- [Bilberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/plants/bilberry/): Vaccinium myrtillus; Bilberry, Whortleberry, Fraochán. In season July to August.

## Dishes

- [Elderflower cordial](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/elderflower-cordial/): Flower heads steeped overnight with lemon, strained into sugar syrup and bottled.
- [Sloe gin](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/sloe-gin/): Frosted sloes steeped in gin with sugar from October until Christmas.
- [Nettle tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/nettle-tea/): Fresh nettle tops steeped in hot water.
- [Rose hip syrup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/rose-hip-syrup/): Hips simmered, double-strained and sweetened; a spoonful of vitamin C.
- [Meadowsweet cordial](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/meadowsweet-cordial/): Almond-scented summer cordial.
- [Mussels in cider](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/mussels-in-cider/): Mussels steamed with Irish cider, shallots and parsley.
- [Periwinkles with a pin](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/periwinkles-with-a-pin/): Winkles boiled in seawater and picked out with a pin, the old seaside treat.
- [Dillisk crisps](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/dillisk-crisps/): Dried dillisk toasted in a dry pan and eaten like crisps.
- [Elderflower fritters](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/elderflower-fritters/): Flower heads in light batter, fried and dusted with sugar.
- [Puffball steaks](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/puffball-steaks/): Thick slices of young puffball fried in butter with garlic.
- [Wild garlic pesto](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/wild-garlic-pesto/): Creamh blended with Irish cheddar, hazelnuts and rapeseed oil.
- [Blackberry jam](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/blackberry-jam/): Late-summer blackberries cooked with sugar and lemon.
- [Rowan and crab apple jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/rowan-and-crab-apple-jelly/): Bittersweet jelly for venison and lamb.
- [Hedgerow jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/hedgerow-jelly/): Autumn hedgerow fruits cooked together and strained.
- [Chanterelles on toast](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/chanterelles-on-toast/): Chanterelles fried in butter with thyme on sourdough.
- [Nettle soup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/nettle-soup/): Nettle tops simmered with potato, onion and stock, blended with cream.
- [Wild garlic colcannon](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/wild-garlic-colcannon/): Mashed potato with wild garlic and butter instead of cabbage.
- [Sea beet and potato cakes](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/sea-beet-and-potato-cakes/): Wilted sea spinach folded into potato cakes and pan-fried.
- [Chicken of the woods stew](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/chicken-of-the-woods-stew/): The mushroom braised with onions, stout and thyme.
- [Porcini and barley risotto](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/porcini-and-barley-risotto/): Pearl barley cooked slowly with porcini and stock.
- [Dillisk soda bread](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/dillisk-soda-bread/): Brown soda bread with flakes of dried dillisk.
- [Wild garlic soda bread](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/wild-garlic-soda-bread/): White soda bread with chopped creamh and cheddar.
- [Carrageen moss pudding](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/carrageen-moss-pudding/): Soaked carrageen simmered in milk, strained and set into a soft vanilla pudding.
- [Fraughan tart](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/fraughan-tart/): Bilberry tart for Fraughan Sunday at the start of August.
- [Blackberry and apple tart](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/blackberry-and-apple-tart/): Irish plate tart of blackberries and apple, with cream.
- [Elderflower and gooseberry fool](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/elderflower-and-gooseberry-fool/): Stewed gooseberries with elderflower folded into whipped cream.
- [Gorse flower cordial](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/gorse-flower-cordial/): Coconut-scented cordial from aiteann blossom.
- [Bog myrtle and heather beer](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/bog-myrtle-and-heather-beer/): Old-style gruit ale brewed with bog myrtle and heather instead of hops.
- [Pickled rock samphire](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/pickled-rock-samphire/): Rock samphire in spiced vinegar.
- [Seaweed chowder](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/seaweed-chowder/): Creamy West Coast chowder with mussels and seaweed.
- [Steamed alexanders with butter](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/steamed-alexanders-with-butter/): Peeled young stems steamed and buttered like asparagus.
- [Pan-fried razor clams](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/pan-fried-razor-clams/): Razor clams seared with garlic and parsley.
- [Field mushrooms on toast](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/field-mushrooms-on-toast/): Fried field mushrooms on brown soda bread.
- [Crispy fried gutweed](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/crispy-fried-gutweed/): Dried gutweed flash-fried crisp.
- [Pepper dulse seasoning](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/pepper-dulse-seasoning/): Dried pepper dulse crumbled over eggs, fish and chips.
- [Cockles and mussels](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/cockles-and-mussels/): Steamed cockles and mussels with cream, garlic and cider, as in Molly Malone.
- [Sea spaghetti carbonara](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/sea-spaghetti-carbonara/): Blanched sea spaghetti tossed with bacon, egg and cheese.
- [Wild mushroom and blewit stew](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/wild-mushroom-and-blewit-stew/): Autumn mushrooms braised with onions and stout.
- [Damson jam](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ie/dishes/damson-jam/): Old-orchard damsons cooked into jam.
